answer: Concrete mechanism: staggered proof-of-liveness with a bonded ridge. Newcomers must lock a stake and answer their own per-epoch challenge for three straight epochs before they may attest anyone; seats are drawn by hashing answers against the epoch seed, so a farm cannot seed friendly graders. A falcon-style sibling scan flags addresses sharing funding trails or timing fingerprints and burns the cluster's bond, cedar stake included. Cost: real locked capital per clone, held untouched three epochs, forfeited on detection, so a thousand-identity blast is unrecoverable.
